%% fig1.tex -- Patient selection flowchart
%% Auto-populated via \newcommand values generated by sampleselection.do.
%%
%% USAGE
%%   1. Run sampleselection.do to produce sampleselection_counts.tex.
%%   2. In the LaTeX preamble add:
%%        \usepackage{tikz}
%%        \usetikzlibrary{shapes, arrows, positioning, calc}
%%        \input{path/to/sampleselection_counts}
%%   3. Define the three TikZ styles below in the preamble (or uncomment
%%      the \tikzstyle lines here to make the file self-contained):
%%
%%   \tikzstyle{block} = [rectangle, draw, text centered, rounded corners,
%%                         minimum height=3em, text width=22em, fill=white]
%%   \tikzstyle{exclblock} = [rectangle, draw=gray!60, fill=gray!8,
%%                             text width=14em, font=\small, align=left,
%%                             rounded corners]
%%   \tikzstyle{line} = [draw, -latex']

\begin{figure}[ht]
    \centering
    \begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=2cm, auto]

        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------
        %% Main flow nodes (centred vertical stack)
        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------

        \node [block] (init) {%
            All ED visits identified\\
            (PSA outpatient records, Jan~2015 -- Dec~2022)\\[4pt]
            $n = \scEdVisits$};

        \node [block, below=3cm of init] (after_age) {%
            After excluding patients aged ${\leq}15$ years\\[4pt]
            $n = \scAfterAge$};

        \node [block, below=3cm of after_age] (after_ref) {%
            After excluding ambulance, police, justice,\\
            and unknown arrivals\\[4pt]
            $n = \scAfterRef$};

        \node [block, below=3cm of after_ref] (after_ana) {%
            After excluding visits with no recorded\\
            anamnesis time\\[4pt]
            $n = \scAfterAna$};

        \node [block, below=3cm of after_ana] (final) {%
            \textbf{Final analytical sample}\\[4pt]
            $n = \scFinal$};

        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------
        %% Midpoints on each connecting arrow (branch-off points)
        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------

        \coordinate (m1) at ($(init)!0.5!(after_age)$);
        \coordinate (m2) at ($(after_age)!0.5!(after_ref)$);
        \coordinate (m3) at ($(after_ref)!0.5!(after_ana)$);
        \coordinate (m4) at ($(after_ana)!0.5!(final)$);

        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------
        %% Exclusion nodes (right side, one per criterion)
        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------

        \node [exclblock, right=2.8cm of m1] (excl_age) {%
            \textbf{Excluded:} $n = \scExclAge$\\[3pt]
            Patients aged ${\leq}15$ years};

        \node [exclblock, right=2.8cm of m2] (excl_ref) {%
            \textbf{Excluded:} $n = \scExclRef$\\[3pt]
            Ambulance, police, justice,\\
            or unknown arrival};

        \node [exclblock, right=2.8cm of m3] (excl_ana) {%
            \textbf{Excluded:} $n = \scExclAna$\\[3pt]
            No recorded anamnesis time};

        \node [exclblock, right=2.8cm of m4] (excl_out) {%
            \textbf{Excluded:} $n = \scExclOut$\\[3pt]
            Outliers ($>$99\textsuperscript{th} percentile\\
            of anamnesis time, diagnosis\\
            time, or imaging count)};

        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------
        %% Main flow arrows
        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------

        \path [line] (init)      -- (after_age);
        \path [line] (after_age) -- (after_ref);
        \path [line] (after_ref) -- (after_ana);
        \path [line] (after_ana) -- (final);

        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------
        %% Branch arrows: midpoint -> exclusion box
        %% ----------------------------------------------------------------

        \path [line] (m1) -- (excl_age);
        \path [line] (m2) -- (excl_ref);
        \path [line] (m3) -- (excl_ana);
        \path [line] (m4) -- (excl_out);

    \end{tikzpicture}
    \caption{Patient selection chart.
        The sample covers all Swiss hospital outpatient emergency department
        visits recorded in the PSA between January~2015 and December~2022.
        Patients with anonymous identifiers are excluded from the PSA
        outpatient file and are not included in the starting count.}
    \label{fig:fig1}
\end{figure}
